uncertain.text: quelles reſultẽt deux preuues frõt diffe-
uncertain.note: sic 'frõt' (for 'fort'): f (ascender height, hooked top, crossbar), r, õ (tilde bar), short t; confirmed at 5x against 'fort' on line 9 and the f's of 'diffe-'. Reader B read 'trõt'. Transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: goce, ordõne que Pierre Cuerre oncle,
uncertain.note: sic 'Cuerre' for 'Guerre'. Cropped this initial and the 'Guerre' of blocks[0].lines[3] at 5x and stacked them: the line-4 G shows the horizontal spur and short stem inside the bowl; this letter is a plain open C, the bowl closing to a beak at top right and a curl at bottom right, with no bar and no stem. Misprint (wrong sort) for Guerre; transcribed as printed. Reader B may normalize to 'Guerre'.

uncertain.text: preuenu. premieremẽt la femme: où led.
uncertain.note: the mark after 'preuenu' is a small lightly inked round dot on the baseline with no tail (5x); read as a period, both readers agree. Sense would run 'audit preuenu premieremẽt la femme' without a stop.

uncertain.text: ment qu'il y auoit peu de iuges aſsiſtans
uncertain.note: 'aſsiſtans', not 'aſſiſtans'. At 6x (body-6.jpg, fourth line, x~1230-1650) the first s of the pair is a full-height long ſ and the second is unmistakably a short round s at x-height with the two s-curves; the following i is dotted and the next letter is again a long ſ before the t. Conventions §2 keeps ſs as printed. Contrast 'perſuadaſſent' on the next line and 'aſſeurer'/'aſſeurée'/'reſſẽble'/'reſſẽblẽt', all of which really are ſſ (checked at 6x-7x).

uncertain.text: celuy martin reſſẽblẽt fort le preuenu. La
uncertain.note: two things on this line. (a) 'martin' is printed with a lowercase m, unlike 'Martin' at lines 3, 4, 7; sic, transcribed as printed. (b) the l of 'reſſẽblẽt' is almost unprinted: at 7x it shows only as a broken, dotted vertical between the b and the ẽ. The letter is there and the word is secure, but a reader working at reading size could read 'reſſẽbẽt'.

uncertain.text: & lad de Rols viendrõt en perſonne. A-
uncertain.note: sic: 'lad' here carries no abbreviation point, while 'lad.' at blocks[0].lines[13] does. Checked at 3.5x; the space between 'lad' and 'de' is clean, with no dot at the baseline. Transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: du Tilh priſõnier eſt cõdẽné perdre la te
uncertain.note: 'cõdẽné' carries two different marks that a reader could level: over the o and over the first e the mark is a horizontal, slightly wavy bar (tilde), while over the final e it is a short stroke slanting up to the right (acute). Compared at 5x with the unambiguous acute of 'rapporté' (line 7) and the unambiguous tilde of 'q̃' on the same line. Same test applied to every tilde on the page; 'roiẽt' (line 2), 'reſẽ-' (line 3) and 'rẽtes' (line 7) are all tildes, not acutes.

uncertain.text: & beaucoup plꝰ que ladite de Rols: telle-
uncertain.note: 'plꝰ' = plus: after 'pl' the print sets the small raised 9-shaped us sign, transcribed ꝰ (U+A770) per conventions §2. Verified at 5x.

uncertain.text: des ſeurs dudit Martin: auec le p̃uenu: deſ
uncertain.note: 'p̃uenu' = preuenu: a tilde is printed over the p (transcribed p + U+0303 per §2). Both marks on this line are colons, not periods: each shows two dots, checked at 3.5x. The word spelt out in full ('preuenu') appears at lines 8, 9, 20.

uncertain.text: Toloſe. laq̃lle vſant de ſon accouſtumee
uncertain.note: sic 'Toloſe' without the h, although the running head of this very page reads THOLOSE; transcribed as printed (§5, §7). 'laq̃lle' = laquelle, with a tilde over the q (q + U+0303).

line-end breaks. Hyphens are printed at lines 1, 3, 6, 9, 18, 23 ('n'oſe-', 'reſẽ-', 'diffe-', 'd'i-', 'A-', 'telle-'). Lines 2, 5, 12 and 28 break a word with NO hyphen ('auſ|ſi', 'deſ|quelles', 'te|ſte', 'in|ſtruite'), which conventions §1 says is normal and needs no entry; recorded here only so the reconciler does not treat a missing hyphen as a reader's omission.

the page has no marginal notes and no letter markers at all. All four margin strips (margin-1..4.jpg) show clean, unprinted outer margin beside every body line, and foot.jpg shows no foot citation block, no signature and no catchword below the last body line. The marker alphabet is therefore not advanced on this page; whatever letter p046 ended on carries over to p048.

block structure. The whole page is one paragraph of 29 lines in the large (TEXTE) type; there is no heading, no decorated initial, no ornament and no break in the column. continues_prev is true (the page opens mid-word/mid-sentence with 'grãde ſimilitude', continuing the preceding page) and continues_next is true (the last line ends 'enquis d'office' with no terminal punctuation and no catchword). decisions.text: quelles reſultẽt deux preuues frõt diffe-
decisions.reason: At 5x the first sort of the word rises to full ascender height (level with the d of 'diffe-' and the f of 'fort' on line 9) with a right-hooked top and a crossbar; the roman t of this fount, as at the end of the same word, is short (x-height plus a stub) with a left flag. So f-r-õ-t: 'frõt', a misprint for 'fort' (transposed sorts), kept as printed.
